name: Inside bar / narrow-range breakout
idea: A signal on the first close beyond a quiet bar: an inside bar, or the narrowest bar of the last few. The idea is wrong beyond the other side of the mother bar.

params.label: The quiet bar
params.help: Which bar the break comes out of.
choice_labels: The narrowest of the last four bars
The narrowest of the last seven bars

params.label: Volume expansion
params.help: The breakout bar's volume must be at least this many times the average (0 means no volume condition; indices have no volume).

params.label: Break distance
params.help: How far beyond the quiet bar the close must be, in average true ranges (0 means any close beyond).
